salt_name.description: Name or identity of the salt used in the isotherm experiment

process_run_id.description: Identifier of the automated process run on the liquid handling system

pump_speed.description: Pump speed used for liquid handling

replicates.description: Number of technical replicates per condition on the plate

resin_mass_mg.description: Mass of chromatography resin loaded per well

ligand_name.description: Name or identity of the ligand molecule

total_volume_ul.description: Total liquid volume in each well during incubation

venting_time_s.description: Venting time used in the automated protocol

pump_duration_s.description: Duration of pumping during loading or equilibration steps

incubation_time_min.description: Incubation time for achieving adsorption equilibrium

salt_concentrations.description: List of salt concentrations used in the isotherm experiment (as provided in metadata)

equilibration_cycles.description: Number of column equilibration cycles performed before loading

ligand_concentrations.description: List of nominal ligand concentrations loaded onto the resin (as provided in metadata)

incubation_temperature_c.description: Incubation temperature during loading isotherm experiment

measurement_wavelength_nm.description: Measurement wavelength used on the plate reader

calibration_curve_slope.description: Slope of the linear calibration curve relating absorbance to ligand concentration

salt_concentration_unit.description: Unit for the salt concentrations, e.g. mM or mol/L

salt_stock_concentration.description: Concentration of the salt stock solution

ligand_concentration_unit.description: Unit for the ligand concentrations, e.g. µM or mg/mL

ligand_stock_concentration.description: Concentration of the ligand stock solution

calibration_curve_intercept.description: Intercept of the linear calibration curve (absorbance at zero concentration)

equilibration_cycle_duration_s.description: Duration of a single equilibration cycle

number_of_salt_concentrations.description: Number of distinct salt concentrations used on the plate

number_of_ligand_concentrations.description: Number of distinct ligand concentrations used on the plate

analysis_status.description: Status of the loading isotherm analysis as reported by the analysis script

analysis_message.description: Human-readable message summarizing the outcome of the analysis

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the commit script packaged the analysis results

summary.description: Key metrics extracted from Langmuir fits and plate statistics

num_ligand_conc.description: Number of ligand concentrations used (from analysis metadata)

num_salt_conc.description: Number of salt concentrations used (from analysis metadata)

replicates.description: Number of replicates per condition as used in analysis

num_wells_analyzed.description: Total number of wells with valid absorbance data used in analysis

num_groups.description: Number of (ligand, salt) condition groups after replicate aggregation

num_fits.description: Number of Langmuir fits attempted (one per salt concentration)

num_successful_fits.description: Number of Langmuir fits that returned finite parameters

r2_min.description: Minimum R-squared among successful Langmuir fits

r2_max.description: Maximum R-squared among successful Langmuir fits

r2_mean.description: Mean R-squared among successful Langmuir fits

fits.description: Per-salt Langmuir fit parameters as reconstructed from the CSV file (if available)

R2.description: Coefficient of determination for the fit

warning.description: Warning or failure reason for this fit

warnings.description: List of warnings emitted by the analysis script

data_files.description: Paths or filenames of main data output files produced by the analysis script

raw_tecan_excel.description: Path to raw Tecan Excel file used in analysis

aggregated_isotherm_csv.description: CSV file with aggregated isotherm data

langmuir_fits_csv.description: CSV file with Langmuir fit parameters

plots.description: Plot files produced by the analysis script

loading_isotherms_png.description: PNG figure with loading isotherms and Langmuir fits
